_doc: NONASK-1103 S1/S1b: deterministic question decomposition. The original question stays authoritative; parts are only extra retrieval handles.
separators_note: item separators are ',', ', and', 'and', 'or', '&', '/'; comparison cues are 'vs', 'versus', 'compare X with/and/to Y', 'difference(s) between X and Y'.

model_fallback._doc: Stub, ships OFF (S3b). Used only when the rules give one part and a list cue exists; output must pass the drift guard. A decomposer callable must be injected; none is bundled.

official_lane._enabled_doc: RETRIEVAL-1109 H-2 (owner OD-1109-RETRIEVAL, "Yes, approve all four"): ON, but pages are READ only for the entities in fetch_entities (FEC, Census Bureau); every other registry row, including the other terms_verdict=allow rows, gives links only. official_lane._site_search_doc: Ships OFF like the lane (enable per docs/lanes-enable-checklist.md). Plan 6.3 step 2: one site:<host> DDG query per allow-verdict entity through the shared DuckDuckGo Lite provider (cache, daily_query_cap, rate gate); links_only/unknown rows never get one. false = entry URLs only.
official_lane._doc: NONASK-1103 S4 official lane (vera/official_lane.py). Ships OFF; enable only per docs/lanes-enable-checklist.md. Fetches only registry docs_entry_urls of rows with terms_verdict=allow, through vera/public_fetch.py (robots on the pinned path); every other row gives links only. No new number: the display cap is the row count of docs_entry_urls (owner-curated).

_calibration_note: max_parts=4 and max_comparison_side_words=8 are UNCALIBRATED priors (2026-11-03). Parts beyond max_parts are merged into the last part, never dropped. generic_terms is a curated list, not a tuned number. Needs the S0 confusion matrix (>=30 multi-entity and >=30 lexically similar controls) before any claim of rate; tests/test_subquery_1103.py is a unit check, not a calibration.
